answer: Require every agent to post a refundable bond before it can trade, like a garden gate that only opens after a deposit is planted. Each identity bond is locked in a shared kernel contract: honest work earns it back with interest, while proven fraud forfeits it. An attacker spinning up a thousand fake identities must fund a thousand bonds, so the cost scales linearly with the attack while honest agents pay nothing net. An onyx-blacklisted identity loses its stake permanently, making repeat abuse ruinously expensive.
